answer: Verify every agent by postal mail, not just code. First, the registry mails a one-time cipher to the agent's claimed address; the agent must type it back within 14 days. Second, each address hosts at most two identities, like a cedar that shelters only a few nests, and each letter costs $2 to send. Third, a forged address triggers a 300 POA bond burn and a 90-day ban. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 5,000 real addresses and $10,000 in postage plus 140,000 days of waiting. Like a voyage with one ticket per cabin, a sybil fleet cannot board without paying for every berth.
